notes.title: Circadial Demo Patch 0.11
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and wishlisted the game! I'm extremely thankful for all the support.

This patch looks to make improvements to the overall demo to improve the graphics quality, optimization, and help improve certain unpolished segments.


[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased overall game resolution from 320 x 240 to 640 x 360.
[*] Adjustments to UI to accommodate new resolution.
[*] Improved optimization (occlusion culling, loading screens, reduced particles).
[*] Added sound and path markers to make navigating the dream sequence easier.
[*] Player speed during the dream sequence was increased.
[*] Sound effects and assets have been added to the lab and dream sequence segments.
[*] Demo ending significantly improved.
[/list]
